deskInvHelpLede: Bills from trusted senders, paid only after approval.
deskInvHelpFlowShort: The issuer sends an invoice to the payer's invoice address. Nothing is paid until the payer approves it.
deskInvHelpFlowIntro: An invoice asks for a payment. The **issuer** is paid; the **payer** decides.
deskInvHelpFlowStep1: The issuer's wallet sends the invoice to the payer's **invoice address** over the Epicbox server.
deskInvHelpFlowStep2: The payer opens it under [[Invoices › Pay]], checks the sender, the amount and the message, and chooses **Approve and pay** with the wallet password.

@deskInvHelpFlowStep2.description: Step 2. [[x]] marks a place in the app; keep the place name as the UI shows it.

deskInvHelpFlowStep3: The payer's wallet sends the payment to the issuer's **payments address**.
deskInvHelpFlowStep4: The issuer's wallet finalizes the payment and posts it to the network. After {confirmations} confirmations it is final.
deskInvHelpFlowNever: Nothing is paid without approval, and an invoice never adds money to the payer's wallet. Each invoice has a time to pay, at most 48 hours; after it, the invoice can no longer be paid.
deskInvHelpFlowIssued: Invoices this wallet issued are under [[Invoices › Issue]].
deskInvHelpTrustShort: Only senders on the trusted list can put an invoice in the inbox. That keeps out spam and fake bills.
deskInvHelpTrustP1: The wallet accepts an invoice only at its invoice address and only from a sender on the trusted list, matched on the sender's address. Anything else is dropped unread, before it is opened, and never shows under [[Invoices › Pay]].
deskInvHelpTrustP2: Without the list, anyone who learned the invoice address could fill the inbox with spam or with bills that look real.
deskInvHelpTrustP3: Trust only lets a sender ask. A trusted sender cannot take anything: each invoice still waits for **Approve and pay**.
deskInvHelpTrustWhere2: Or switch on **Trusted for invoices** on a contact under [[Contacts]].
deskInvHelpTrustWhere3: A sender can be removed from the list at any time. Its new invoices are then dropped.
deskInvHelpAddrShort: Invoices arrive at their own address, apart from the payments address that people pay to.
deskInvHelpAddrP1: The wallet has two Epicbox addresses. The **payments address**, under [[Receive]], receives payments. The **invoice address** receives only invoices.
deskInvHelpAddrP2: Keeping them apart means the invoice address can be given to services, or replaced, without exposing or changing the address people pay to.
deskInvHelpAddrP3: The invoice address does not receive payments: a payment sent to it is dropped. To be paid, give the payments address.
deskInvHelpAddrWhere1: Find, copy or show the invoice address as a QR code under [[Settings › Invoices]].
deskInvHelpAddrWhere2: **New invoice address** replaces it. Services with the old one can no longer send invoices until they get the new one.

@deskInvHelpAddrWhere2.description: List item; 'New address' is the button's label.

@deskInvHelpDiagramTitle.description: Caption over the invoice flow diagram.

@deskInvHelpDiagramPayer.description: Diagram lane: the side that pays.

deskInvHelpDiagramSemantics: The issuer sends an invoice to the payer's invoice address, which accepts trusted senders only and drops the rest; the payer reviews and approves it; the payment goes to the issuer's payments address; the issuer's wallet finalizes it and posts it to the network.
